resources.string: Orders are offered by how close you are, so nothing can reach you without it.
Allowed only while the app is open
It works this way. If your phone sleeps for a long time you may stop receiving orders.
Turn on location services so the restaurant can see where you are — you\'re still shown as available, but no live position is reaching the server.
You will not be alerted for a single offer until you turn them back on — nothing else in the app can wake your phone.
Notifications are on, but the offer alert itself is turned off in your phone\'s settings.
An offer can arrive without a sound right now, and you could miss it. Let this app through in settings, or turn Do Not Disturb off.
Open the app to accept before it expires.
